dispositions.quote_before: Third, never discourage a call to the police. Under California Civil Code section 1946.8, a lease can't limit a tenant's right to call for help, and a landlord can't penalize them for it.
dispositions.quote_after: Third, don't discourage calls for help. California Civil Code section 1946.8 protects calls about abuse, crime or an emergency when the caller believes help is needed. A lease can't restrict those calls, and a landlord can't penalize a tenant or resident for them.

dispositions.quote_before: Fourth, treat every security report as notice. Reply the same day, fix it, write it down, and watch for patterns.
dispositions.quote_after: Fourth, as a best practice, acknowledge security reports promptly, assess the urgency, arrange needed repairs and keep a record. A report about a required lock can give notice under California's lock statute; other reports may raise different duties.
